deliverable: A reversible stock BO3 engine patch, a shareable Windows patch-loader executable, and a reviewed real pull request.
reportedSymptoms: Long AAE Zombies matches can show Connection Interrupted.
Repeated Pack-a-Punched War Machine fire is a reported trigger.
The failure may occur in solo and co-op, but occurs more often in co-op.

firstCapture.hostRole: Record the actual role. Host on the capture PC for a co-op server capture.

hypotheses: Projectiles, power-ups, or other server entities exhaust a resource.
Temporary effects or network events exceed a limit during a volley.
Projectile cleanup or script tasks accumulate over repeated volleys.
An unrelated script error or network failure ends the match.

limits: Connection Interrupted alone does not identify the exhausted resource.
OS threads are not GSC script threads.
Window response is not internal server health.
A failure snapshot needs the manual marker while the process is alive.
A process exit is recorded automatically, but a full exit-time dump is not guaranteed.
No debugger, DLL injection, engine patch, or game configuration change is part of this first capture.

diagnostics.liveScriptVariables: Separate read-only sampler passed ten owned native E2E cases and fresh review. The shared entity sampler still passes 22 cases. Game measurements remain unvalidated and the private game profile is disabled.
diagnostics.scriptCleanup: Native entity deletion queues notify and suspended-stack cleanup. Normal VM work drains the queue. Completion for one known grenade allocation lifetime has not been observed.
diagnostics.entityLifetime: The verified native reuse version repeats after 63 complete free/spawn cycles. Equal samples do not prove one lifetime. Strict correlation needs allocation/free events, world epochs, and loss detection. That recorder remains unimplemented.
diagnostics.savedErrors: Private bounded inspection found empty saved engine error buffers in the startup and menu captures. Neither is a failing Zombies capture.
diagnostics.compatibility: Current stock runtime uses 10-bit network entity IDs. Expanding normal IDs past 1023 conflicts with unpatched clients.
diagnostics.loader: Native cooperative-fixture foundation only. Game safe point and engine patch remain unimplemented.
